scope: reviewed noun-subject negative past-progressive and past-habitual constructions
rule: In the reviewed CUN paradigm, negative past progressive uses ma cunayn/cunaynin across persons, while negative habitual past uses ma cuni jirin across persons. These negative forms neutralize person; do not require separate masculine, feminine, or plural endings. Exact affirmative past-progressive or habitual auxiliary forms after ma are review conflicts.
evidence: Qaamuuska Af-Soomaaliga (Puglielli & Mansuur, 2012), Shaxannada CUN, pp. 921-922
safety: Exact reviewed forms only. Unknown lookalikes remain unjudged. No suffix-only derivation and no automatic rewrite.
